$comment: Dataset classes of the synthetic-data domain: test data with known answers (the generator and its scorer).
description: Synthetic test data with a hidden answer key: the people generated, and the activity facts derived from them.

synthetic_people.description: The generated people: the truth the scorer compares against. Passed between the generator's nodes in memory.

synthetic_activity.description: The activity facts derived from the people, before they are written as damaged system exports. Passed in memory.
